history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure a phased plan is developed for the issuance of the guidance to operationalize the delegation of authority and closely track the progress thereof.
history.administration_response: As part of the roll-out strategy of the revised delegation of authority policy and related instrument, the Monitoring of Delegation of Authority Section is working on an upgraded delegation of authority frequently asked questions tool, which will be more client-friendly than the existing tool. In addition, it will facilitate the search for information and the provision of responses beyond topics limited to delegation of authority thanks to linkages with other guidance and policy resources hosted on the Knowledge Gateway, maintained by the Department of Operational Support. The Section has been tracking all questions raised by entities since the launch of the policy revision exercise and will use the upgraded frequently asked questions tool to address all of them in this structured repository. The upgraded frequently asked questions will be a live tool, regularly updated with the latest questions from entities and answered with the help of the policy and business owners. The recommendation will be implemented once the updated tool has been launched in production on 18 BTAD-Square.
history.board_assessment: Given that the Monitoring of Delegation of Authority Section is working on an upgraded delegation of authority frequently asked questions tool, the Board considers this recommendation to be under implementation.

history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration ensure that a phased plan is developed for the issuance of the guidance to operationalize the delegation of authority and closely track the progress thereof.
history.administration_response: As part of the roll-out strategy of the revised delegation of authority policy and related instrument, the Administration launched an upgraded delegation of authority question-and- answer tool in August 2022. Users can navigate by topic and search for specific content, which is reviewed and updated on a continuous basis to address issues raised by clients and capture policy developments and new guidance as well as tool enhancements and monitoring updates. Launched on the Knowledge Gateway, the updated delegation of authority question-and- answer tool provides users with links to the latest available operational guidance (e.g. links to the latest guidelines on the acceptance of voluntary contributions issued in July 2022 and to the guidelines on the use of corporate credit cards issued in June 2022). The updated question- and-answer tool, launched in August 2022, had already been updated with new entries in September 2022 and will continue to be enhanced. The Administration considers this recommendation implemented and requests its closure.
history.board_assessment: Given that the upgraded delegation of authority question-and-answer tool was launched in August 2022, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
